spans.s:
अर्पय अर्पय, Caus. of rt. ऋ; अर्पयति,
[]
-यितुम्, to throw, cast; insert, fix; pierce, place in
or upon; offer, deliver, consign, entrust, give back.

अर्पण, अम्, n. throwing, casting; inserting, fix-
ing; piercing; placing in or upon; offering, delivering,
consigning, entrusting; giving back.
अर्पण, अस्, आ, अम्, to be delivered, to be placed.

अर्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, delivered, consigned; placed
in or upon.
—अर्पित-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, extending or
giving the hand; married.

आर्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, fastened to, annexed; depend-
ing on.
अर्प्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be delivered, consignable.
आर्पय् आर्पय्, Caus. fr. rt. ऋ with आ. See 2. आर्.
आर्पयितृ, ता, m., Ved. one who injures or hurts.
